about.npc_follow_leader_hint: Checked: every account teleports to the zaap, then the group leader turns on follow (Ctrl+W by default) and is the only one to walk; the others follow. Unchecked: each account walks by itself.
about.npc_follow_delay_hint: Time given to the maps to load after the zaap, before the group leader turns on follow. Raise it if some accounts don’t follow: your PC needs more time to load the maps.

game_keys.intro: The keys ROrganizer presses in Dofus for the invite, zaap and NPC buttons. Use the same as in the game’s shortcuts.
game_keys.prompt: Press the key or combination used in Dofus

help.minimize_to_taskbar: Checked: “–” and “Activate” minimize the window to the taskbar, at the bottom of the screen, to keep the buttons one click away. Unchecked: it hides in the system tray, near the clock.
help.shortcuts_only_in_dofus: Checked: your shortcuts do nothing while you are in another application (browser, Discord…); the key works normally there. Unchecked: they work everywhere.
help.always_on_top: Checked: the window stays above all the others, even when you click Dofus. Unchecked: it goes behind, like a normal window.
help.group_leader: The account that invites the others, that the others follow on an NPC trip, and that the app comes back to after a group command. By default, the first of the list.
